invariants.statement: Target Automatron is never an attackable combat target.
A passive, unrelated Target Automatron may not be the sole reason farming navigation cannot progress.
Unknown monster content remains fail-closed until explicitly classified safe.
Dangerous special fairies and custom target exclusions remain blocked for attack and navigation release.
Self-aggro, selected, or planned monsters are never silently removed from navigation blockers by the Automatron recovery.
When useful work is expected, attack rejection plus navigation rejection must still leave a safe alternate action or an explicit safe stop.
In a healthy actionable fixture, the Farmer state machine reaches travel, engage, attack, navigation, or an explicit safe stop within a bounded number of ticks.
A healthy complete team waiting only for cohesion must have a bounded leader recovery move that reduces pairwise distance instead of waiting forever.
Merchant rendezvous movement may only be created by real transfer or supply work, never by ordinary status traffic or an empty outbound queue.
A blocked or failed merchant rendezvous must be deferred so bank, market, gear, restock, and other home service can continue.
Alpha21 may promote a farm objective only from measured party performance and approved content after bounded stable evidence, never from a hard-coded level guide.
Alpha21 may recommend a better cross-map farm area but must not acquire direct smart-move or other new travel authority to execute it.
Raw Adventure Land target state must never replace the Farmer-owned target as combat ownership authority, while self-aggro remains a hard safety hold.
Kill and damage performance telemetry may only attribute a monster to the Farmer-owned target or verified self-aggro, and an owned disappearance requires XP evidence to count as a kill.
A live compound transaction must reserve all three identical inputs atomically and release the full reservation set together on every terminal outcome.
Real upgrade and compound actions must commit only from verified item and scroll deltas; ambiguous outcomes fail safe and may not be blindly replanned or retried.
A running shadow Farmer must periodically advance shadowPlanRevision rather than remain permanently at zero.
Merchant control/economy authority must not implicitly acquire Farmer combat authority.
Critical Farmer, reliability, and Merchant runtime modules must remain free of circular dependency chains.
Supervisors may halt or degrade automation but must never bypass TargetSafety or fail-closed content boundaries to manufacture progress.
